# F16: New goal fits a phone: first field and Continue on the first screen, no step over two screens, 44 px controls (F16)

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/11-new-goal-phone.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

New goal on a phone (onboarding spec, section 6; OB1). At 390 × 844 and 360 × 800, on each of the four steps: the step's first field and its primary button are on the first screen with the keyboard closed; no step is taller than two screens (the measure step with the plan table folded); every control is at least 44 px high, "Change" included; nothing scrolls sideways; nothing covers Back or Continue, and the tab bar doesn't show (focus mode). Set-up's steps join this check with OB3.

## Where it looks

- 390 × 844, as mateo, at `/goals/new`, on a touch screen
- 360 × 800, as mateo, at `/goals/new`, on a touch screen

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- {at}: the first field is not on the first screen
- {at}: the primary button is not on the first screen (reported when `primary.y < 0`)
- {at}: something covers {covered.join(' and ')}
- {at}: the tab bar or sidebar shows; New goal is focus mode
- {at}: the step is {tall}px tall, over two screens (reported when `tall > 2 * h`)
- {at}: scrolls sideways ({sw} > {iw})
- {at}: controls under 44px: {small.slice(0, 4).map(([n, x]) => `${n} ${x}px`).join(', ')}
